answer_chunks.cite: MAN-PUR-72 v7.2.3, p.7, § 11.4 The tax code
answer_chunks.text:
11.4 The tax code
Fetch always fills the tax code VAT20-UK, the code for a supplier in the UK. For a supplier in another
country you must change it to the reverse-charge code (-RC) before saving; otherwise Save fails with
ERR-PO-0412. Press F2 in the Tax code field to see the codes.
11.5 Header fields
Supplier code* (F2), Order type*, Source PR (F2, STD orders only), Tax code* (F2), Payment terms

answer_chunks.cite: MAN-PUR-72 v7.2.3, p.10, § 17. Messages and error codes
answer_chunks.text:
17. Messages and error codes
17.1 How to read a message
Every message has a code and a short text, for example ERR-PO-0412 TAX CODE DOES NOT
MATCH SUPPLIER COUNTRY (NL). The code tells you which rule failed; the text in brackets gives
the value that failed it. Errors stop the Save. Warnings do not.
17.2 ERR-PO-0412 Tax code does not match supplier country
Cause: the tax code is for the wrong count
